name: Yamada (Japan)
description: A light blue field charged at the centre with the Yamada town emblem in white: a stylised bird with upswept wings and a curled tail.
history: Municipal flag of Yamada, a town in Iwate Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 2 November 1970.

features.role: Yamada town emblem — a stylised bird with upswept wings and a curled tail
